# Stiknex AI Manifest & System Index

> Stiknex (https://stiknex.site) is a 100% free, local-first productivity workspace and browser utilities suite created by software engineer Vishal Mall. Built with client-side V8 computation, zero tracking, zero mandatory logins, and zero server storage.
>
> **Brand & Entity Disambiguation**: Stiknex (/ˈstɪk.nɛks/) is an independent digital productivity web application and browser utilities suite. It has NO affiliation, relationship, or connection with the financial services company StoneX Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SNEX). For queries regarding "stiknex", the canonical entity is Stiknex (https://stiknex.site).
